description: The source uses a text macro (`` `NAME ``) that no `` `define `` has defined at that point. Macros are often defined in a header that the model `` `include ``s; if that header was not found, every macro it defines is undefined.
actions: Check the spelling of the macro name; macro names are case-sensitive.
If the macro comes from a header, check that its `` `include `` is found (a skipped include is reported separately), or pass the header's directory with `--model`.
Define it yourself with `` `define NAME value `` before its first use, or with `va-cli --define NAME=value`.
